reward_model: independent Bernoulli pilot and fresh main streams; fixed probabilities and policy
allocation_space: every positive integer four-vector summing to B_main=B_total-K*m0; first computed numerical minimum in lexicographic allocation order; mathematically equivalent floating ties may differ by roundoff
fixed_nonlinear_oracle: knows true p; chooses one allocation minimizing unconditional nonlinear risk before pilots
adaptive_nonlinear_oracle: knows true p and realized pilot counts; chooses allocation minimizing conditional nonlinear risk before fresh main sampling
development: all 96 original K4 heterogeneous vectors and original six regimes from CPU gate 20261011_run01; outcomes previously seen, development only

confirmation.components: 16 independent vectors each from Beta(.5,.5), Beta(2,2), Beta(8,8), Beta(.5,3), Beta(3,.5), and logistic-normal with shared location N(0,1) and scale exp(Uniform(log(.15),log(3)))
confirmation.no_selection: every generated vector is retained; distribution unchanged from original mixture

primary_estimand: adaptive-nonlinear-oracle versus matched uniform and variance-only, confirmation distribution; equal components, equal pilot settings, vector clusters
secondary: fixed nonlinear oracle, old local oracle, JADA and development/stress results; no tuning on confirmation
uncertainty: no Monte Carlo reward error: all pilot/main count states summed exactly. Population uncertainty uses stratified vector-cluster paired covariance and contrast-specific Welch-Satterthwaite Student-t delta-method intervals
headroom_rule: HEADROOM if both primary relative-reduction lower 95% limits exceed 5%; LIMITED_HEADROOM if both upper limits are at most 5%; otherwise INCONCLUSIVE. Headroom is an unattainable-information diagnostic, not a deployable method or an online-training GO.
limits: Only K4/B16 and declared pilot/reuse settings. A negative result cannot rule out larger budgets; a positive result does not establish that pilot-only allocation can attain the oracle.
